research_catalog.sql:
CREATE VIEW research_catalog AS
            SELECT entity_id AS id,kind,name,description,source_id,source_path AS locator FROM entities
            UNION ALL
            SELECT record_id,kind,name,description,source_id,source_locator FROM curated_records
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'observation:comp:' || comp_id,'composition',coalesce(name_source_keys,comp_id),
                'Observed PBE composition. Query v_comp_observations for sample counts, metrics, and window limits.',
                source_id,source_path FROM observation_comps

v_abilities.sql: CREATE VIEW v_abilities AS SELECT e.*,a.unit_id,a.variant,a.form_source_key FROM abilities a JOIN entities e ON e.entity_id=a.ability_id

v_augments.sql: CREATE VIEW v_augments AS SELECT e.*,a.rarity,a.augment_type,a.rounds_json,a.round_variants_json,a.tags_json,a.quest_related FROM entities e JOIN augments a USING(entity_id)

v_cashouts.sql: CREATE VIEW v_cashouts AS SELECT * FROM supplemental_cashouts

v_comp_observations.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_comp_observations AS
        SELECT s.sample_id,s.comp_id,c.name_source_keys,s.sample_count,
               max(CASE WHEN m.metric='average_placement' THEN m.value END) AS average_placement,
               max(CASE WHEN m.metric='win_rate' THEN m.value END) AS win_rate,
               max(CASE WHEN m.metric='top_four_rate' THEN m.value END) AS top_four_rate,
               max(CASE WHEN m.metric='population_share' THEN m.value END) AS population_share,
               s.requested_window_days,s.window_status,s.updated_at,s.source_id,s.source_path
        FROM observation_samples s JOIN observation_comps c USING(comp_id)
        LEFT JOIN observation_metrics m USING(sample_id)
        WHERE s.record_kind='composition' GROUP BY s.sample_id

v_coverage.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_coverage AS SELECT *,
            CASE WHEN expected > 0 THEN round(100.0 * observed / expected,2) END AS inventory_percent,
            CASE WHEN applicable_fields > 0 THEN round(100.0 * known_fields / applicable_fields,2) END AS basic_field_percent
            FROM coverage_entries

v_effects.sql: CREATE VIEW v_effects AS SELECT e.name,e.kind,v.* FROM effect_values v JOIN entities e USING(entity_id)

v_evidence.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_evidence AS
            SELECT a.entity_id,a.field_path,a.value_json,a.source_id,a.source_path,d.url,d.sha256,d.retrieved_at
            FROM assertions a JOIN source_documents d ON d.source_id=a.source_id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT a.record_id,a.field_path,a.value_json,a.source_id,a.source_path,d.url,d.sha256,d.retrieved_at
            FROM curated_values a JOIN source_documents d ON d.source_id=a.source_id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT a.source_id || ':' || a.source_path,a.source_path,a.value_json,a.source_id,a.source_path,d.url,d.sha256,d.retrieved_at
            FROM supplemental_values a JOIN source_documents d ON d.source_id=a.source_id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'observation:comp:' || a.comp_id,'$',a.raw_json,a.source_id,a.source_path,d.url,d.sha256,d.retrieved_at
            FROM observation_comps a JOIN source_documents d ON d.source_id=a.source_id

v_items.sql: CREATE VIEW v_items AS SELECT e.*,i.category,i.unique_item,i.stat_line,i.tags_json,i.collection FROM entities e JOIN items i USING(entity_id)

v_loot.sql: CREATE VIEW v_loot AS SELECT e.*,l.owner_source_key,l.drop_table_source_key,l.outcomes_status FROM loot_tables l JOIN entities e USING(entity_id)

v_loot_outcomes.sql: CREATE VIEW v_loot_outcomes AS SELECT * FROM supplemental_loot_nodes

v_observations.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_observations AS
        SELECT s.*,c.name_source_keys FROM observation_samples s LEFT JOIN observation_comps c USING(comp_id)

v_recommended_items.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_recommended_items AS
      SELECT u.unit_key,u.table_key,i.item_key,i.item_index,u.definition_status,
             u.source_id,u.source_path AS unit_source_path,i.source_path AS item_source_path
      FROM supplemental_unit_recommendations u
      LEFT JOIN supplemental_recommended_items i ON u.table_key=i.table_key

v_system_curves.sql: CREATE VIEW v_system_curves AS SELECT * FROM supplemental_curves

v_traits.sql: CREATE VIEW v_traits AS SELECT e.*,t.trait_type,t.effects_source FROM entities e JOIN traits t USING(entity_id)

v_units.sql:
CREATE VIEW v_units AS
 SELECT e.*,u.cost,u.shop_unit,u.shop_tier,u.pool_count,u.pool_cost,u.role,u.unit_kind,u.locked,u.board_slots
 FROM entities e JOIN units u USING(entity_id)

v_unlocks.sql: CREATE VIEW v_unlocks AS SELECT e.entity_id,e.source_key,e.name,u.cost,e.source_id,r.* FROM unlock_rules r JOIN units u ON u.entity_id=r.unit_id JOIN entities e ON e.entity_id=r.unit_id
